content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"review","note":"The FAD's path from evidence to conclusion can be partly traced through ROI citations, but key premises do not match the record: the finding that the IPO used 'mothering' only once and that only Subordinate-1 and Subordinate-2 used it conflicts with the IPO's January 31 memo (ROI at 118) reporting such complaints from all three subordinates, and the finding that Complainant first objected on February 24 conflicts with her account of objecting on January 31."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most characterizations carry ROI page citations, but several material points lack a traceable source: the mediation-driven 'changes that allegedly came about' (FAD at 29) are uncited to evidence, the disputed written apology from the IPO has no identified source, and the suggestion that Subordinate-3 used another demeaning term rests only on an EEO counselor report not otherwise in evidence."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Core events are dated (Oct 2019, Jan 31, Feb 24-25, Mar 2020, May 13-15, May 31, Jun 15, 2020; Apr 19 and Jun 3, 2021), but the HR-1 phone call is undated, the 'four-month period' of direct tasking is not anchored, the significance of the 'March 5, 2020' date in the complaint is unexplained, and Complainant's own EEO counselor contact date is not stated."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who authored or reviewed the FAD, and although Complainant's April 19, 2021 objections about uninterviewed witnesses (Subordinate-2, Subordinate-3, HR-2) prompted April 22-27 emails, nothing documents whether or how those objections were considered or resolved before the June 3, 2021 decision."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because three potentially material witnesses were never interviewed, the FAD contains internal inconsistencies with the ROI, and there is no documented handling of the identified omissions, an independent reviewer cannot assess from the record alone whether the harassment and liability findings are supported."}}}
